const r=await tools.exec_command({cmd:"@'
# Independent visual QA — #82 registration and one-time welcome grant

Issue: [#82](https://github.com/dystrophyless/dubbed.ai/issues/82), verified registration / one-time grant. Reviewer: **GPT-6.1 Sol, High**, dedicated to this issue only. Date: **2026-10-25**, Windows local mocked frontend. Verdict: **changes recommended**; 0 HIGH, 4 MEDIUM, 2 LOW. This review does not reopen the issue or change its accepted mock scope.

## Snapshot and method

Code HEAD: `9d286621177200fdb5f61ef963d0b6818ae76774`. The working tree already contained modified documentation/skills and historical evidence plus untracked flow/reference/QA material. No product source was modified by this reviewer. Only `issue-82/` review artifacts were written; the dedicated Vite server used port **4382** and was stopped afterward.

Read the dispatched live issue snapshot (`../contracts/issue-82.md`; supplied packet says zero comments), Flow 03, shared visual/token authority, HANDOFF, SDD entry point, Ponytail full, spec-task-review and both design skills/app-screen guidance. Current local contracts govern this review; old acceptance and memory are provenance rather than fresh verification. Semble located `RegistrationScreen.tsx`, `OtpInput` and mock identity seams before direct source inspection.

Commands: `npm.cmd run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4382 --strictPort` from `frontend/`; `node issue-82/capture.cjs`; `node issue-82/fault-capture.cjs` from repository root with full paths. Installed Playwright Chromium, headless, isolated contexts; muted audio and fake media flags. Native browser journeys went from Landing's Start dubbing through visible form, delivered **local simulated** code, invalid entry, correction and completion. No email, Google provider, backend or real account was used. The six supplemental screenshots use the existing `auth-state-visual` harness, overriding facade results; these prove rendering under injected outcomes, not live service behavior.

All screenshots referenced in findings were opened with `view_image`; all 23 captured states were visually inspected. Full-page PNGs deliberately reveal overflow and below-fold content; their pixel height is not the configured viewport height. Geometry and font metrics were collected after `document.fonts.ready`. Browser zoom is 100%; DPR defaults to 1. This was a bounded review, not a full suite.

## User job and acceptance evidence

The visitor needs to create one verified account, enter its six-digit code without losing work, understand recovery, and arrive signed in at New dub with the eligible welcome balance. Registration submission alone must never create a session/grant.

| AC / state | Expected | Fresh actual / evidence | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| AC-01 form | One password, labels, minimum 8, recoverable validation | One password; empty form gives field-below errors, native EN desktop captures 01/02 | Partial pass; 7/8 boundaries and managers not rerun |
| AC-02 invalid code | Retain six digits, select for replacement, error below, no blind retry | 04 retains digits; DOM selection `[0,6]`; 05 ArrowLeft changes selection to `[0,0]`; no visual difference in selection/caret | Logical behavior works; QA-82-02 visual defect |
| AC-03 pending/reload/correction | Restore email/code entry without secret restoration; fresh password for correction | RU native 11–14 restores address and code-entry, clears code and correction password | Partial pass; limits/expiry/replacement not rerun |
| AC-04 completion | Correct code opens New dub, eligible 120 grant | Native 08 goes directly to New dub with Credits 120; 09 reload still120 | Observed UI pass; atomic/exactly-once ledger and session duration not established |
| AC-05 collision | Account already exists, Sign in/Reset password, no overwrite | Injected collision20 presents both links and no code field | Render pass only; race/no-write invariants not retested |
| AC-06 deleted identity | New account, no restore/repeat grant | No fresh deleted-account scenario | Not run |
| AC-07 EN/RU / responsive | Readable controls, no overflow, localized recovery | Desktop EN/RU, phone EN/RU, short desktop, 767/768 captured; long email breaks width | Refuted for long content: QA-82-01 |
| AC-08 unknown/failure simulation | Distinct uncertainty and honest simulation labels | Injected18 retains code, disables mutable actions, provides Check status;21 keeps form/error; native mock notice explicitly says no email sent | Render pass; real service unverified |
| AC-VIS-01 submitting | In-place busy action; source-mapped code/controls | Injected19 replaces the entire form with Checking registration status | QA-82-03; additional source deviations below |

Evidence index: [native metrics](metrics.json), [injected-state metrics](fault-metrics.json), [capture log](capture-log.json), [screenshot manifest](screenshot-manifest.json). Native08/09 are the completion proof; no separate success screen is required. Recovery screenshot13 was captured immediately after restoration and contains a checking notice; it is not used to assert a persistent stuck-state defect.

## Findings

### QA-82-01 — MEDIUM — Long accepted email expands code-entry beyond the phone and tablet viewport

**Classification:** confirmed implementation defect. **Affected:** AC-03/07, AC-VIS-01; Flow03 §4.3 long-address reflow.

**Reproduce:** use390×844, Start dubbing, enter `averylonglocalpart.abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789@averylongsubdomain.abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz.example.invalid`, an8+ character password, Create account. The local service accepts this address and presents verification. Repeat at767/768.

**Expected:** full address remains accessible while wrapping/truncating within the form, with no page horizontal scroll. **Actual measured:** at390 the document is **965px** wide; the292px form column grows its child actions to **916.28px**, putting their centered labels outside the initial viewport. At767 the document is1117px; at768 it is1125px. This is content-triggered, independent of simulated code delivery. It harms address checking and makes Change email appear to be an unlabeled strip until the user pans sideways.

**Source:** `frontend/src/features/auth/RegistrationScreen.tsx:1035–1038` interpolates the complete address into an unconstrained paragraph. `frontend/src/features/auth/auth.css:40–45` uses grid descendants without a shrink/wrap safeguard. A wrapping address class exists at132–136 but this paragraph does not use it.

**Recommendation:** constrain the grid's shrinkable content and apply address wrapping to the actual destination paragraph, preserving its accessible full value. **Next validation:** same accepted address plus long RU copy at320/390/767/768; assert `scrollWidth <= innerWidth` and all action labels remain visible.

![Long address expands390px page to965px](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/_docs/evidence/proactive-visual-qa-2026-10-25/issue-82/evidence/15-long-email-en-phone.png)

### QA-82-02 — MEDIUM — The logical OTP selection and insertion position have no visible equivalent

**Classification:** confirmed implementation/usability defect against the adopted OTP focus/editing treatment. **Affected:** AC-02/07 and AC-VIS-01; Flow03 §5.4.

**Reproduce:** enter an incorrect six-digit value. Observe the retained code, then press ArrowLeft. Alternatively enter only123 and move left/right. **Expected:** users can tell which digits are selected and where replacement/insertion occurs. **Actual:** only the entire group gets a blue outline. Invalid selection changes from `[0,6]` to `[0,0]`, but screenshots04/05 are effectively identical. The partial123 state also shows no active cell/caret. Native editing still works; the problem is missing visible editing feedback, not missing logical selection.

**Source:** `OtpInput.css:59–68` makes the sole input opacity.015 and caret transparent; `OtpInput.tsx:42–49` renders static digit spans with no selection/caret mapping. The Clean source explicitly tracks an active-cell ring/caret (`otp-input-clean.md.txt:673–689`, initial Light PNG); the accessibility adaptation may strengthen the ring, but removing current-position feedback is not documented.

**Recommendation:** retain one accessible input and expose its selection/insertion state visibly on the cells, including selected-invalid replacement; do not split this into six independent fields. **Next validation:** keyboard arrows, whole selection, paste, pointer editing and replacement in EN/RU, while asserting both logical selection and a visible state.

![Invalid retained digits with logical whole-value selection](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/_docs/evidence/proactive-visual-qa-2026-10-25/issue-82/evidence/04-invalid-en-desktop.png)

![After ArrowLeft, insertion at beginning is visually indistinguishable](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/_docs/evidence/proactive-visual-qa-2026-10-25/issue-82/evidence/05-invalid-caret-en-desktop.png)

### QA-82-03 — MEDIUM — Slow registration removes the submitted form instead of showing in-place busy feedback

**Classification:** confirmed implementation mismatch, proved with an injected pending service promise. **Affected:** AC-01/07, AC-VIS-01; Flow03 §5.2.

**Reproduce:** existing harness URL `e2e/harness/auth-state-visual.html?screen=register&scenario=register-loading`, fill the visible fields and submit. The harness holds `registration.start`; it does not model a real network. **Expected:** submitted Create account action shows in-place busy feedback, blocks duplicate starts and retains the form. **Actual:** the email/password/action all disappear; only Checking registration status remains beneath the old heading. The page collapses markedly and the user loses the submitted context. Duplicate requests are guarded, but that narrower behavior does not satisfy the visual contract.
